report.summary: Consolidation of v-offload and v-gated_writes: two CONFIRMED high-risk issues in path isolation and case handling, and two UNDECIDABLE items needing offload.py inspection.

todos.task: Enforce write-scope in isolate_paths mode or document risk
todos.details: isolate_paths assumption not enforced; only documented. Undetected writes outside declared paths could lead to data exfiltration or corruption. Add enforcement (e.g., worker path restriction) or explicit documentation of bypass risk.

rebase_declared_path does not normalize path case before relative_to comparison, causing silent failure on Windows when resolved path and primary_root differ only in case. Use os.path.normcase or case-insensitive alternative.
Scoped snapshot only hashes declared paths, may miss writes outside. Could lead to undetected integrity violations. Document limitation clearly or use full-repo snapshot when possible.

rebase_declared_path catches ValueError but not OSError from p.resolve() if path does not exist, causing unhandled exception. Add OSError catch and emit logging.warning before returning raw path or raising descriptive exception.

handoff.suggestion: Apply the listed actions: enforce write-scope, add case normalization, address snapshot limitation, and add OSError catch. The UNDECIDABLE items require inspecting offload.py for missing verification gates.
